title: Hong Kong blow for Alexandra Eala as American Claire Liu ends title wait
text:
Hong Kong blow for Alexandra Eala as American Claire Liu ends title wait | South China Morning Post Tennis - Tennis Hong Kong blow for Alexandra Eala as American Claire Liu ends title wait Advertisement Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open Sport Tennis Hong Kong blow for Alexandra Eala as American Claire Liu ends title wait 
 Filipino superstar ends stellar season on low note, going down to a straight-sets final defeat by an inspired 26-year-old opponent
 1 -MIN READ 1 -MIN Listen Paul McNamara Published: 6:07pm, 8 Nov 2026 Updated: 6:25pm, 8 Nov 2026 Claire Liu delivered an inspired performance to disappoint Alexandra Eala’s army of supporters, beating the Filipino in straight sets on Sunday to claim the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open title.
 After breaking Liu to lead 2-1 in the opening set, Eala dropped 11 of the next 12 games to lose 6-3, 6-0 in one hour and 33 minutes.
 The opening game of the second set proved pivotal, Eala aiming a forehand into the net to drop serve following a run of 11 deuces.
